contradictions.what: Rep named Raj (CTO) as final decider, then said Angela signed with Adyen.
Raj 'ran the RFP' as decider, but rep later says 'Probably Angela' and Raj's support rests on his own word.
Rep says they were ahead and had won the web side, yet knew on the drive home it was lost; lead was web-only.
Rep met Angela once, yet she signed and drove key asks; Raj was the contact 'the whole way'.
Our slide pitched unified commerce; the customer never used that term and called it a diagram.
